subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should OpenClaw change the default visible-reply policy for direct/source chat turns to message-tool-only or final-only, or keep automatic bare-text replies as the compatible default with opt-in leak guards?
rationale: The remaining fix changes source-reply semantics and security posture: suppressing automatic text protects external recipients, but existing users may depend on automatic bare-text replies.

options.title: Default to explicit delivery
options.body: Make source-channel replies private unless the message tool or a final-only contract explicitly sends them, with migration/docs for existing automatic-reply users.

options.title: Keep automatic defaults with opt-in guards
options.body: Preserve automatic bare-text replies while improving documented opt-ins such as visibleReplies=message_tool and final-tag enforcement.

options.title: Land only partial layer fixes
options.body: Review the open gateway/final-tag candidate PRs independently and leave the larger default-policy change for later.

recommendation.title: Default to explicit delivery
recommendation.body: Make source-channel replies private unless the message tool or a final-only contract explicitly sends them, with migration/docs for existing automatic-reply users.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is a product/security default for core source-reply delivery, and steipete is the strongest current-main routing signal for the relevant files in this checkout.
